verdict: Your Google profile is the only active channel and needs attention now.
narrative: This period, no paid advertising ran on Meta or Google Ads, so your Google Business Profile was the sole source of measurable marketing activity. Over the full 28 days, your profile generated 42 actions from 333 impressions — a reasonable baseline. However, that activity came to a complete stop in the most recent 7 days (September 11–17), with zero actions recorded each day after averaging roughly 2.4 per day the week prior; we are investigating whether this reflects a drop in local search visibility or a broader shift in demand. Website sessions were up 14% week-over-week despite no paid spend, which is a quiet positive, though conversion tracking is being repaired so that number under-reports actual outcomes. Restoring paid activity and resolving the profile visibility drop are the immediate priorities heading into next week.
